use_case_summary: Goal: automate triage and create structured ticket objects from emails/chat. Want hosted API to return deterministic JSON so our downstream lambdas can map directly to ticket fields. Prefer function-calling for actions (create_ticket, escalate, add_comment). Target: P95 latency <500ms for short summaries; peak throughput ~40-60 reqs/sec during business hours. Cost sensitivity: pilot under credits, expected ARR small but steady if conversion to paid hosted API occurs.
technical_requirements:
- Structured output enforcement (JSON schema)
- Tool/function-calling hooks to POST to internal ticket API
- Audit logs for actions taken and content summaries
- SSO for admin console (SAML)
- Retention controls for transcripts (30-90 days configurable)
model_preferences_and_routing: Prefer an open-model variant (cost vs quality tradeoff) — will evaluate Redwood-verified small/medium models first. Want fallback to cheaper model for low-priority tickets and automatic routing to higher-quality model for escalation. No on-prem or VPC needed today; public cloud hosted API is fine.
commercial_notes: SMB budget; procurement via credit conversion. Likely to commit to usage-based hosted API if pilot shows clear unit economics and simple billing. Estimated ARR band provided by customer success expectation: 5k-20k/year.
next_steps_detail: 1) AE to send hosted-API quickstart + sample cURL and SDK examples (done, emailed). 2) SE-led 30m technical walkthrough (propose 2026-03-16). 3) Provide a templated JSON schema + sample function-calls to wire into their lambda. 4) Track legal review — push for simplified MSA for SMBs.
deal_risks: Primary risk is slow legal turnaround and mismatch on structured schema (they require deterministic keys). Also sensitive to per-token costs; will benchmark against cheaper open providers if pricing unclear.
